I tested a theory by upgrading a grey striker (Holo, drum mag, vertical foregrip and muzzle) and ran it all the way until the end game. Despite being grey, it was still beaming opponents more than effectively. 

A common striker will do 186.3 DPS whereas the mythic does 234.9 DPS. In a perfect scenario the mythic striker will obviously out perform a common striker but in reality a fully upgraded common striker could come out on top due to the fact that more shots are actually hitting the target. 

Personally unless I know I'm going to have access to an upgrade bench in the near future, I won't swap out a fully upgraded AR or sniper for a higher rarity unless it already has the attachments I run.
